/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import csv
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
values = ['2025-03-03','2024-07-12','2026-07-04','2023-09-21','2019-11-05','2024-02-29','2025-10-01','2025-06-08','2027-12-31','2022-05-14','1937-05-27','2026-01-02','2028-02-15','2025-11-01','2024-08-09','1990-04-23','2021-10-03','2023-06-30','2026-01-15','2025-12-01']
lines = Path('sentences.txt').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(values)
rows = [(line.split('\\t', 1)[0], date.fromisoformat(value).isoformat()) for line, value in zip(lines, values)]
with Path('dates.csv').open('w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, lineterminator='\\n')
    writer.writerow(['id', 'date'])
    writer.writerows(rows)
with Path('dates.csv').open(newline='') as f:
    assert list(csv.reader(f)) == [['id', 'date']] + [list(row) for row in rows]
print('Created and verified dates.csv with 20 rows.')
PY"
